name: encode
setup: ch = encode([1 0 1 1], 7, 4, 'hamming/binary'); c2 = encode([1 0 1 1 0 1 0 0], 7, 4, 'hamming/binary'); cc = encode([1 0 1 1], 7, 4, 'cyclic/binary'); [~,g] = hammgen(3); cl = encode([1 0 1 1], 7, 4, 'linear/binary', g); cd1 = encode(11, 7, 4, 'hamming/decimal'); [cp, added] = encode([1 0 1 1 0], 7, 4, 'hamming/binary');
comment: Sig: [code,added] = encode(msg,n,k,method,opt). Linear block encoder over GF(2): reshape msg into k-bit words, multiply (mod 2) by the k x n generator. Methods hamming/linear/cyclic with /binary (default) or /decimal format. encode([1 0 1 1],7,4,'hamming/binary')=[1 0 0 1 0 1 1]; cyclic=[0 0 0 1 0 1 1]; encode(11,...,'hamming/decimal')=88; 5-bit msg pads added=3. New (Error Correction Codes / block linear codes) 2026-06. BCH/RS (gf type) deferred.
